purpose: Close ASVS V5.2.6 on the attachment upload route. A file of a few dozen bytes could declare an enormous image and be handed to tesseract or ImageMagick, because nothing read the declared dimensions. The 8 MB file-size limit bounds the decoder's input, not its output, and the 30 s runBinary timeout bounds time, not resident memory. Adds header-only geometry reading with fail-closed width, height, per-image pixel and cumulative per-request limits, enforced before the decoder runs.
requiredInvariants: No new dependency. sharp exists only as a pnpm.overrides pin and does not resolve from apps/web, and apps/web declares no image library; adding a native dependency would need licence, provenance and SBOM review and is not done here.

No reliance on an external decoder for the check. Dockerfile.web copies only convert into the runtime image - identify is never copied - and the build environment has no convert, magick, identify, tesseract or pdftoppm at all, so an external-binary design could not be verified by running it.
This is not a general image parser. It reads three specified header structures for the three formats the route actually accepts, with a bounds check on every read and a hard cap on iteration count.
Fail-closed on an unreadable or truncated header. IHDR, SOF and ispe are mandatory in their formats, so failure to read them means malformed, and nothing can be asserted about such a file's safety.

Overflow-safe by ordering: width and height are each compared against their limits before any multiplication, so the product cannot leave the safe integer range. Frame count is applied only after the per-frame area is already bounded.
The check runs before the file is written to disk and before tesseract or convert is invoked.
A rejected file spends no budget, so one oversized upload cannot deny the remaining files in the same request.
Existing limits are untouched: MAX_FILES, MAX_FILE_BYTES, MAX_TOTAL_BYTES, OCR_TIMEOUT_MS and MAX_OCR_PDF_PAGES are unchanged, and the content-signature check from #4671 is not weakened.

Two gaps are recorded in the register note rather than left implicit: the decoder's own resident-memory limit is not introduced here, and the PDF rasterisation path is not covered - pdftoppm renders by page geometry and MAX_OCR_PDF_PAGES bounds page count, not page size.
The cryptographic inventory is regenerated by script only; adding image-dimensions.ts moves the tracked source count from 2151 to 2152, which the staleness test compares exactly.
apps/landing is not touched. No production, REG.RU, DNS or database mutation.
acceptance: A PNG under 80 bytes declaring 65535 x 65535 is refused before any decoder is invoked.
Width, height, per-image pixel and cumulative per-request limits each reject one over the boundary and accept exactly the boundary.
Zero dimensions, 32-bit boundary dimensions, malformed and truncated headers are all refused with distinct codes.
APNG frame count and multiple HEIC ispe boxes are counted, so frames cannot smuggle area past the per-image limit.
Neutralising the check fails 12 of the 21 spec cases.
V5.2.6 moves FAIL to PASS with six self-revoking conditions, all 13 negative checks revoke, and the matrix rebuilds at applied 332 / rejected 0 with FAIL falling from 120 to 119.
